findings.note: RotoWire notes say Makar had 13 shots on goal in his first five games this season, about 2.6 per game, and 199 in 75 games in 2025-26, about 2.65 per game. Both rates are just above the 2.5 line.

NHL.com's Oct. 15 status report says Makar came back for Wednesday's home game against Dallas after missing Tuesday's game for the birth of his twins. Nothing found says he is unavailable for Pittsburgh, but no game-day report for this matchup was found.
Makar has averaged 21:30 of ice time this season, below last season's 24:51, after a preseason lower-body injury. Fewer minutes could keep his shot total down.
